items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: He was a great guy and become a good friend and a big help for Lily on the tour.

ctx.x: Somebody signalled us that there was a singer named Miriam Burton in town. Miriam had been the leading singer in Katerine Dunham's group fo singers and had beautiful suprano voice. She was not a jazz singer really, but on ballads, she was wonderful. So, we engaged her also.

We paid every musician a half day salary for rehearsing. That was a gesture that we decided to do in order to become better friends with the guys. We also put in the contract that everyone would be paid a half day salary whenever we had an off day during the tour. We had hired a bus and the driver was an ex-wrestler named Louis Lamy. He was a great guy and become a good friend and a big help for Lily on the tour. He owned the bus and had some others that he rented for tours.

On Monday, the 13th of October, the first concert was given in le Havre. We were a little bit nervous, but Dickie was not in his usual form. He said that he had caught a cold because he didn't have an overcoat, and had to have some "grogs"(toddy). But we had a nice success and we were preparing for the concert in Paris at Salle Pleyel which taken place the 18th of October.
